responsibility: Declares the internal analysis and state-tracking machinery used by the AVR late `avr-fuse-move` RTL pass implemented in `avr-passes.cc`. It models known byte values in general-purpose registers (`memento_t`), abstract byte expressions and candidate move/operation rewrites (`absint_byte_t`, plies-related helpers), and per-basic-block optimization state (`bbinfo_t`) so the pass can reason about register contents after reload, search alternative instruction sequences, and choose profitable move-fusing, constant/materialization, and small algebraic simplifications specific to AVR’s 8-bit register file.
